motion.name: stage-glyph
motion.purpose: Only the running stage moves; none under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts an investigation or saves settings.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #0161dd; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; font: 550 14px 'Funnel Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #047bf2; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #63adf7; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.css: .ds-glass { color: #ececef; padding: 18px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .1); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .075), rgb(255 255 255 / .028)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .16), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .32), 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / .26); }

components.name: Quoted Evidence
components.description: Source excerpt with the passage the finding rests on.
components.html: … the original shows a single-headed cobra photographed in India …
components.css: .ds-quote { margin: 0; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .2); font: 14px/1.7 'Funnel Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: #ececef; } .ds-quote mark { background: rgb(4 123 242 / .32); color: inherit; padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

keyCharacteristics: Gray page, glass surfaces, two blues.
Glass only where something sits behind it.
Verdict colors only for verdicts; blue never means true.
Funnel Display for headings, Funnel Sans for text.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: The passage a finding rests on is marked with Bright Blue at 32%, never with a new color.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase labels above headings.
